get.description: Public WeChat server URL validation endpoint for QR code capable social connectors. The connector verifies the request signature against its configured token and the verified `echostr` is returned as plain text. Invalid signatures are never acknowledged. Dev feature.

200.description: The verified echo string, returned as `text/plain`.

422.description: Dev features are disabled, or the connector does not support QR code callbacks (including invalid signatures).

post.description: Public WeChat event push endpoint for QR code capable social connectors. The raw XML body is verified (and decrypted in safe mode) by the connector; a qualifying SCAN or subscribe event atomically confirms the pending QR code session for the event's scene (first scan wins). All valid events are acknowledged with `success` as `text/plain`. Invalid signatures, app ID mismatches, and encryption mode mismatches are rejected and never acknowledged. Dev feature.

200.description: The acknowledgment response, returned as `text/plain` (`success` for valid events).

400.description: The request payload is missing or malformed (e.g. no XML body).

422.description: Dev features are disabled, the connector does not support QR code callbacks, the signature or encryption mode is invalid, or the payload is malformed.
